Install linux-omarchy-muqss-headers on Omarchy

Headers and scripts for building modules for the Omarchy Linux (MuQSS CPU scheduler) kernel

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add linux-omarchy-muqss-headers
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 7.2.8-8:
    pacman -Qi linux-omarchy-muqss-headers

Open and use linux-omarchy-muqss-headers

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

Frequently asked questions

How do I install linux-omarchy-muqss-headers on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add linux-omarchy-muqss-headers. The download is 94 MB and it takes 342.8 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is linux-omarchy-muqss-headers free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed GPL-2.0-only.

How do I uninstall linux-omarchy-muqss-headers?

Run omarchy pkg drop linux-omarchy-muqss-headers. It removes the package from your system.

What does linux-omarchy-muqss-headers depend on?

The package declares 9 dependencies: binutils, glibc, libelf, libgcc, openssl, pahole, xxhash, zlib, zstd. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is linux-omarchy-muqss-headers in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as linux-omarchy-muqss-headers (version 7.2.8-8) in the official Omarchy package repository. Project site: https://omarchy.org.
